title: Build the Shift Coverage vs Demand Check Premium Blueprint (private preview)
objective:
Build the Premium Blueprint described in agent-specs/ai-staffing-optimizer.json. Read that spec, agents/standards.md, and AGENTS.md first.
Create the public guided demo at /blueprints/ai-staffing-optimizer and the signed-in Premium kit at /blueprints/ai-staffing-optimizer/kit.
Kit contents: Coverage Check Setup Checklist; Coverage Check Prompt; Four-Week Re-Check Prompt; Staffing Rules Worksheet; Hourly Coverage Workbook Template; Schedule Change Review Checklist; Fictional Sample Hourly Export; Data and Safety Guidance.
Follow every entry in the spec's constraints list.
Do not commit, push, merge, deploy, or publish.
acceptance_criteria: GET /blueprints/ai-staffing-optimizer without a session renders a page whose h1 is 'Shift Coverage vs Demand Check', with a visible 'Private preview' label.
The guided demo page's HTML contains a robots meta tag whose content includes 'noindex' and 'nofollow'.
The guided demo page shows the fictional data notice text exactly as specified in guided_demo.fictional_data_notice, above the first demo step.

The guided demo is a six-step stepper. It shows the text 'Step N of 6', a 'Next step' button (absent or disabled on step 6), and a 'Previous step' button (absent or disabled on step 1). Each step has a visible heading.

Step 1 shows a table with exactly 2 data rows whose day-hour labels are Tue 14:00 and Sat 12:00, with Tue values 12, 10, 11, 11 and 4, 4, 4, 4 and Sat values 90, 82, 88, 92 and 3, 3, 3, 3. It also shows 'minimum 2', '15-25', and text about flagging only when outside target in 3+ of 4 weeks.
Step 2 shows the exact heading 'OWNER RULES FIRST'. It shows OWNER-ENTERED minimum '2', target '15-25', and text that a single week outside the target is not enough to flag.

Step 3 shows CONFIRMED Tue formula text '=12/4' and '3.0', '=10/4' and '2.5', '=11/4' and '2.8', and text that Tue is below target in 4 of 4 weeks; Sat formula text '=90/3' and '30.0', '=82/3' and '27.3', '=88/3' and '29.3', '=92/3' and '30.7', and text that Sat is above target in 4 of 4 weeks. Over and under flags use visible text and an icon, not color alone. The text labels 'CONFIRMED', 'OWNER-ENTERED', 'AI INTERPRETATION', and 'RECOMMENDED ACTION' appear as words.

Step 4 shows the Tue 14:00 CONFIRMED line. Activating 'Check facts against the export row' reveals four week rows with matching transaction and staff values, each containing the text 'Matches'. AI INTERPRETATION contains 'prep' and 'POS export does not show'.

Step 5 shows RECOMMENDED ACTION text containing '2 on floor' and 'Tue 14:00', and Sat text containing 'adding 1' and '22'. It shows a mock re-check with Sat inside 15-25 and Tue still below target, plus the sentence 'Re-check the same blocks after 4 weeks with a new export.'.

Step 6 contains the exact sentences 'You edit the schedule in your own tool. The kit changes nothing.', 'Do not cut below your minimum staff.', and 'Check local scheduling and break rules before changing posted shifts.' and a link to /blueprints/ai-staffing-optimizer/kit whose visible text says sign-in is required and the kit is a private preview.
Every day-part, transaction count, staff count, and ratio in the demo matches the guided_demo.sample_input rows and sample_output exactly.

Neither page contains the text 'checkout', 'buy now', 'purchase', 'Buy Premium', '/month', or 'per month'. The only numeric staffing figures are the fictional hourly counts, ratios, minima, and targets from the sample.
Neither page contains an hours-saved figure, a 'you could save' claim, or an ROI or savings-total claim.
The homepage (/) and the site header contain zero links whose href includes '/blueprints/ai-staffing-optimizer', and /sitemap.xml does not contain '/blueprints/ai-staffing-optimizer'.
GET /blueprints/ai-staffing-optimizer/kit without a session redirects to /auth with the query parameter next=/blueprints/ai-staffing-optimizer/kit.

Shift Coverage vs Demand Check is registered in src/lib/blueprints.ts with id and productSlug 'ai-staffing-optimizer', title 'Shift Coverage vs Demand Check', access 'premium', href '/blueprints/ai-staffing-optimizer/kit', purchaseHref '/blueprints/ai-staffing-optimizer', and badge PREMIUM. It is not added to PAID_PRODUCTS and has no Stripe price.

The kit page calls requireUser('/blueprints/ai-staffing-optimizer/kit') from src/lib/auth.ts and hasActiveEntitlement(user.id, 'ai-staffing-optimizer') from src/lib/payments/access.ts. It exports metadata with robots { index: false, follow: false }.

With an authenticated entitled session, the kit page renders h1 'Shift Coverage vs Demand Check Premium Kit' and the exact label text 'Premium · Private preview'. Kit resource and interaction criteria below apply only to this entitled state.

With an authenticated session that has no Shift Coverage vs Demand Check entitlement, the kit page renders h1 'Premium is locked', does not render kit content sections such as #setup-checklist, and does not show a Buy Premium button or a Stripe price.

The kit page shows 8 resource sections with headings matching the kit_contents titles, each with an element id equal to its kit_contents id. A table of contents at the top links to each section with an href of '#<id>'.

The Coverage Check Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains these strings: 'OWNER RULES FIRST', 'CONFIRMED', 'OWNER-ENTERED', 'AI INTERPRETATION', 'RECOMMENDED ACTION', 'transactions per staff-hour', '3 of', 'Do not invent', 'Do not edit', 'minimum', 'You edit the schedule'.
The Four-Week Re-Check Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains: 're-check', '4 weeks', 'target', 'Do not invent', 'Do not edit', 'You edit the schedule'.

Each prompt has a 'Copy Prompt' button that writes the exact <pre> text to the clipboard and changes its label to 'Copied'. If the clipboard is unavailable, it shows a visible error telling the person to copy manually.

The Staffing Rules Worksheet has a visible label 'Minimum staff on floor' whose default value is '2', a visible label 'Target transactions per staff-hour (low)' whose default value is '15', a visible label 'Target transactions per staff-hour (high)' whose default value is '25', a visible label 'Flag when outside target in at least N of M weeks' whose default N is '3' and M is '4', a visible label 'Roles that cannot be cut (one per line)' whose default includes 'keyholder', a visible label 'Non-sales day-parts (optional, one per line)', plus a 'Generate My Staffing Rules' button.

With the defaults, the generated rules block contains 'Minimum staff on floor: 2.', 'Target transactions per staff-hour: 15-25.', 'Flag only when outside target in at least 3 of 4 weeks.', 'Protected roles: keyholder.', 'Do not invent transaction counts or savings.', and 'Do not edit schedules or contact staff. You edit the schedule in your own tool. The kit changes nothing.' The block has a Copy button.

If the minimum-staff field is empty, 0, or negative, the worksheet shows the error 'Enter a minimum staff of 1 or more.' and generates no rules block. If either target bound is empty or the low bound is greater than the high bound, the worksheet shows the error 'Enter a target range with low less than or equal to high.' and generates no rules block.

When 'Non-sales day-parts (optional, one per line)' is empty, the generated rules block contains no 'Non-sales day-parts' line. When it contains 'Tue 14:00-16:00 prep' on one line, the block contains 'Non-sales day-parts: Tue 14:00-16:00 prep.'.

The Hourly Coverage Workbook Template shows the columns day, hour, week1_tx, week2_tx, week3_tx, week4_tx, week1_staff, week2_staff, week3_staff, week4_staff, week1_tx_per_staff_formula, week2_tx_per_staff_formula, week3_tx_per_staff_formula, week4_tx_per_staff_formula, weeks_outside_target, flag, notes. Its 'Copy CSV' button writes text whose first line starts with 'day,hour' and whose Tue row contains '14:00', '=12/4', and '3.0'.

The Schedule Change Review Checklist shows 9 checkbox items with visible labels, a progress line 'Checked N of 9', and a 'Reset checklist' button that sets the count back to 0. Progress is not saved beyond the browser session.
The Fictional Sample Hourly Export section is labelled 'Fictional' and its Copy CSV text equals the day,hour,week1_tx through week4_staff rows and header from guided_demo.sample_input.
The Setup Checklist and the Data and Safety Guidance sections each state that file upload support and data controls in ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini differ by plan, account, and admin settings.
The kit page says that worksheet entries and checklist progress stay in this browser session and are not saved to Atlas.
With an authenticated entitled session, /my-blueprints shows the Shift Coverage vs Demand Check card as Unlocked with an Open Blueprint link to /blueprints/ai-staffing-optimizer/kit.

With an authenticated session that has no Shift Coverage vs Demand Check entitlement, /my-blueprints shows the Shift Coverage vs Demand Check card as Locked with an Available to purchase link to /blueprints/ai-staffing-optimizer and no link to the kit.

With an authenticated session, /my-blueprints still shows the free Daily Inbox Starter Kit with Open Starter Kit pointing at /blueprints/daily-inbox-briefing/starter-kit. AI Collections Assistant entitlement, Buy Premium, and checkout behavior are unchanged. Other Premium Blueprint entitlement and locked or unlocked card behavior are unchanged.

At a 393px-wide viewport, neither page scrolls horizontally (document scrollWidth minus clientWidth is 1px or less) on any demo step or kit section. Tables either wrap or scroll inside their own container.

Every interactive control on both pages can be reached with Tab and activated with Enter or Space, and shows a visible focus ring. After 'Next step' or 'Previous step', focus moves to the new step's heading.
Loading both pages produces no unexpected browser console errors or page errors, as judged by the e2e/support/fixtures.ts console filter.

Product implementation files live under app/blueprints/ai-staffing-optimizer/, components/premium/ai-staffing-optimizer/, and src/lib/premium/ai-staffing-optimizer/. The Blueprint registry entry lives in src/lib/blueprints.ts. e2e/ai-staffing-optimizer/authenticated.spec.ts is the protected acceptance test and must not be weakened, skipped, rewritten, or have assertions removed.

Authenticated QA uses the repository's automatic Playwright session refresh. If the session cannot be refreshed, QA stops with AUTH_SESSION_REFRESH_REQUIRED and that failure is not treated as a product defect.
The guided demo at /blueprints/ai-staffing-optimizer renders without sign-in on desktop and a phone-sized viewport, uses only fictional data, and says so.
The kit at /blueprints/ai-staffing-optimizer/kit requires sign-in, is labelled Premium · Private preview, and shows no price, checkout, or purchase claim.
Both pages set robots noindex and are not linked from the homepage, header, or sitemap.
Confirmed facts, owner-entered inputs, AI interpretation, and recommended actions are labelled separately, and every external action stays with the person.
The Daily Inbox Briefing, its Starter Kit, and its tests are unchanged.
Confirmed facts, AI interpretation, and recommended actions are labelled separately, and every external action stays with the person.
